abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
_curatorNotes: N and C cancel frames not explicitly set in gcsim attack.go — InitNormalCancelSlice(hitmark, animLength) is used for all 4 hits with no subsequent ActionAttack/ActionCharge overrides. AnimationLengths: N1=32, N2=46, N3=34, N4=99. Only swap recorded per hit (= hitmark per InitNormalCancelSlice). KQM frame cross-check needed.

chargeFrames not available: Diluc's charged attack is a stamina-drain spinning slash (claymore type); no explicit chargeFrames slice in gcsim character dir. Reviewer to source from KQM or game testing.
High plunge variant exists in gcsim (highPlungeFrames) but is not represented per recipe — low plunge is the standard rotation animation. plungeFrames sourced from lowPlungeFrames.
gcsim restricts plunge invocation to AirborneXianyun-launched only — sim limitation, not in-game one. In-game any post-jump plunge works.

abilities.name: Searing Onslaught (E1)
abilities.description:
First press of Searing Onslaught: a forward slash that deals Pyro DMG.

This skill can be consecutively used 3 times.
Enters CD if not cast again within a short period.
_curatorNotes: chainStage(skill, 0, window: 4) — cold open of the 3-press Searing Onslaught chain. After firing, parser advances to chain index 1 with a 4s window before reset.

10s cooldown set on this stage only — chain stages 2 and 3 carry cooldown 0 because gcsim only calls c.SetCD on case c.eCounter == 1. Each stage has its own ability id and therefore its own charge queue, but stages 2/3's queues are always available.
No cooldownStartDelay (gcsim uses SetCD, not SetCDWithDelay).

Particle generation: 1 Pyro particle per cast (33% chance of 2), gated by a 0.3s particle ICD across the chain (gcsim particleICDKey). Not modeled as an effect; reviewer to wire energy generation if needed.
Generator stub had `behavior: 'stance'`; corrected to 'instant' — Diluc does not replace N or charge during the chain window.

abilities.name: Searing Onslaught (E2)
abilities.description: Second press of Searing Onslaught (within 4s of E1): a forward slash dealing Pyro DMG with different timing and damage multiplier than the first press.
_curatorNotes: chainStage(skill, 1, window: 4) — fires when chain position is 1 (after E1, within 4s). After firing, parser advances to chain index 2 with another 4s window.

abilities.name: Searing Onslaught (E3)
abilities.description: Third press of Searing Onslaught (within 4s of E2): the final slash of the chain dealing Pyro DMG. The chain resets after this press.
_curatorNotes: chainStage(skill, 2) — terminal stage; no `window` field signals 'reset chain to 0 after firing.' Matches gcsim's behavior of deleting eWindowKey + resetting eCounter to 0 after E3.

swap=66 sourced via the InitAbilSlice-arg-as-swap exception — no explicit ActionSwap line follows skillFrames[2]'s init in gcsim. N=58 is included because skillFrames[2] is the only one of the three stages that explicitly sets ActionAttack.

abilities.name: Dawn
abilities.description:
Releases intense flames to knock back nearby opponents, dealing Pyro DMG. The flames then converge into the weapon, summoning a Phoenix that flies forward and deals massive Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path. The Phoenix explodes upon reaching its destination, causing a large amount of AoE Pyro DMG.
The searing flames that run down his blade cause it to be infused with Pyro.
_curatorNotes: Phoenix entity: gcsim spawns the strike at burstHitmark=100 frames, then 8 DoT ticks at 12-frame intervals (~1.6s of DoT), then an explosion at ~1.7s after spawn. Modeled as a single Phoenix summon with duration 1.7s, spawnsAt 100. mobility 'stationary' per recipe — the phoenix moves forward in a fixed trajectory anchored to the cast direction (not following the caster).

Pyro infusion on Diluc's weapon lasts 8s base (gcsim duration=480 frames). A4 (Blessing of Phoenix) extends the infusion by 4s (to 12s total) and adds +20% Pyro DMG during the infusion window. The infusion is a duration-bounded self-buff (no spawned entity), per recipe section 3 'Duration-bounded self-status'. Not authored as a top-level duration on the burst and not on summons[]. The +20% Pyro DMG portion is captured on the Blessing of Phoenix passive's pre-existing effect skeleton (inherited manual trigger; see passive notes).

Generator stub had top-level `duration: 8` (matching the infusion duration). Removed per recipe — behavior:'instant' bursts do not carry a top-level duration. Reviewer to author the infusion as a self-buff once the schema mechanism for infusion windows is settled.

burstHitmark=100 is the strike-firing frame. The schema has no hitmark-on-burst field; the value is captured here as `summons[0].spawnsAt` (the Phoenix is the entity that carries the strike + DoT + explosion).
ActionDash is not explicitly overridden on burstFrames (defaults to 140 / animation length); D omitted per recipe. ActionBurst, ActionCharge — not applicable on burst frames.
Particle generation: burst does not generate particles in gcsim.

passives.name: Relentless
passives.description: Diluc's Charged Attack Stamina Cost is decreased by 50%, and its duration is increased by 3s.
_curatorNotes: No effects authored. Pattern 5 (stamina-cost / damage modifier with no animation change). Stamina is not modeled in the planner, and the +3s CA duration is also stamina-related. Both parts are practically inert in the planner. Reviewer to confirm no schema action is needed.

passives.name: Blessing of Phoenix
passives.description: The Pyro Infusion provided by Dawn lasts for 4s longer. Additionally, Diluc gains 20% Pyro DMG Bonus during the duration of this effect.
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onCast burst 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim adds the Pyro DMG StatMod with key burstBuffKey for 720 frames = 12s on burst cast (gated on Ascension >= 4). Authored without ascension condition since DEFAULT_ASCENSION=4 covers it. The infusion-extension to 12s total (8s base + 4s A4) is a separate mechanic not represented as an effect entry.

constellations.name: Conviction
_curatorNotes: C1: +15% DMG vs enemies with HP > 50%. Authored 2026-05-11 via the new `enemyHpAbove` Condition variant (mirror of `enemyHpBelow`, shipped E2-partial). Resolves to null at planner-time so the buff renders optimistically with the standard 'assumed to hold' caveat (same treatment as Razor C2 / Yanfei C1 / Eula C4 enemy-HP gates). The 'specific enemy class' gating in the original gcsim code is approximated as an unscoped DMG bonus — over-renders against ALL Diluc damage but matches the schema's existing per-effect granularity (no per-enemy-target routing in the model).
[caption-sweep 2026-07-20] Caveat added when constellation passive-trigger bonuses were wired into the Always-on caption: the null-resolving gate lists optimistically.
constellations.description: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.
constellations.caveat: Listed as always active; in game the DMG bonus only applies against opponents above 50% HP.

constellations.name: Searing Ember
constellations.description:
When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s.
This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s.
_curatorNotes: No effect authored. Pattern: stack-on-hit buff (max 3 stacks) granting +10% ATK + 5% ATK SPD per stack, 10s duration, 1.5s ICD between stack additions. Likely trigger: `onPlayerHit` (gcsim subscribes to event.OnPlayerHit) with `target: self`, `duration: 10`, `value: 10` (atk%) per stack and `value: 5` (atkspd%) per stack, `procCooldown: 1.5`, max 3 stacks. Schema has no stack-count concept on effects; reviewer to decide whether to extend or to model as a single 30%/15% buff with caveats.

constellations.name: Fire and Steel
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Searing Onslaught by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Flowing Flame
constellations.description:
Casting Searing Onslaught in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt.
2s after casting Searing Onslaught, casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s.
_curatorNotes: No effect authored. Conditional skill DMG buff: +40% DMG to the next Searing Onslaught cast, but only if cast in a 2s window starting 2s after the prior cast (i.e. 2s–4s post-cast). Likely target: self, conditional ability: 'skill'. Schema has no 'time-since-prior-skill' condition. gcsim implementation: AddAttackMod with key 'diluc-c4-dmg' on a 120-frame timer queued at hitmark+120. Reviewer to model.

constellations.name: Phoenix, Harbinger of Dawn
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dawn by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark
constellations.description:
After casting Searing Onslaught, the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%.
Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo.
_curatorNotes: No effect authored. Two parts: (a) +30% DMG and +30% ATK SPD on the next 2 Normal Attacks within 6s after any Searing Onslaught cast — likely `onCast` with `ability: 'skill'`, `target: self`, `duration: 6`, `conditions: { ability: 'normal' }`, hit-cap 2. (b) Searing Onslaught preserves the NormalCounter (gcsim restores savedNormalCounter on Attack when in SkillState). The hit-cap-of-2 and combo-preservation are both not directly representable in the schema. Reviewer to model.
